topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 26 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); role-gated via AccessControl; built on solmate.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc721holder, erc165, baseadaptor). Dominant framework: solmate.
